unit: indexed normalized source character intervals, Python half-open offsets
primary: annotated source pairs with at least one complete official rationale set visible
policy: Scan the same five BGE-ranked chunks in both arms. Admit whole spans only. Candidate unions touching or overlapping intervals of the same indexed source before charging; skip a candidate that exceeds the same token budget. Keep source IDs and gap boundaries.
retention_gate: Any newly lost complete rationale blocks promotion. Report every changed query, including mixed gains and losses. No threshold tuning or alternate budgets.
exposure: Existing source-component-disjoint confirmation partition of SciFact TRAIN. Previously examined by other retrieval studies. No question or label selects this policy or its settings.
